section_intro:
This layer is `ProjectModel.roles` and the standing debts that travel with it: section 7 states the three role sentences as one statement, and section 8 states, as facts, what is not established.

SECTION 7 IS A SUMMARY, AND IS HELD TO A SUMMARY'S DISCIPLINE. Every clause of it restates a block of sections 1 to 5, and no clause of it may be stronger than the block it restates: where the earlier block attaches a caveat — a registered quantifier wider than the computation behind it, a venue whose value set forecloses the shape being looked for, a ledger ITEM this document has already corrected, a gate whose check cannot fail — that caveat is carried here, in the sentence that needs it and in the scope cell, or the claim is not made. Clauses found stronger than their sources in this pass are corrected in the blocks below rather than annotated here.

THIS HEADER STATES NO NUMBER, NO ROW AND NO COUNT OF ITS OWN. `replicate/check_proof.py` parses `### P-` blocks and nothing else, so a substantive claim made in a header would be a claim outside the five-cell contract and outside the gate. Everything of substance in this layer is in a block below, with its rows, its statuses and its carrier marks.

SECTION 8 IS NOT THE LIMITS STATEMENT, but less of `T-17` is outstanding than this section previously claimed. The ledger's `BLOCKED` rows are all named below, in P-ROLES-11, with the note that their texts predate `T-41`. Section 8 also now carries the debt this document's own writing created, stated last, in P-ROLES-13, so that a reader who stops at the end of the section still reaches it. What `T-17` still owes is the other half of its DONE_WHEN, the plain sentence about what this program is and is not, and that belongs in this document's next pass.

claims.headline: the three roles as one statement, every load-bearing clause on a two-carrier row
claims.prose: The roles layer states the program's account of what carries a record as one statement: EM supplies the complex and the record, Gamma supplies space, writer, protection and channel, and alpha sets the cost. Every load-bearing clause of that statement cites at least one row carrying the TWO-CARRIER mark of the sealed T-9 audit, and no load-bearing citation is WITHDRAWN, FAILED or RECLASSIFIED; the per-clause table is LANE_T15_ROLES/A_PR_RESTATED.md and the condition is checkable by grep against LANE_T9_AUDIT/T9_carrier_audit.tsv, where all seventeen load-bearing rows verify TWO-CARRIER and live. THE SEALED LANE'S CONDITION HAS SINCE MOVED UNDER IT IN ONE PLACE, AND THIS DOCUMENT IS THE REASON. The lane's own column header reads 'load-bearing (all TWO-CARRIER, live, non-PARTIAL)', and C-72 is no longer non-PARTIAL: the erratum this document's writing produced moved it to PARTIAL, blocked by T-50. Sixteen of the seventeen still meet the sealed condition in full. The seventeenth is C-72, load-bearing on the EM world clause alone, and that clause is carried here only in the form C-72 still holds — the accumulate-versus-screen discriminator and the closed-form floor beneath the occupancy ratio — never as the ratio law, which is not stated as a prediction anywhere in this layer. Exactly one cited row holds status PROVED, C-71, and it is the only such row in the program. The statement restates registered rows and carries their tiers unchanged — corner clauses are FORMAL results about DEF-A, world clauses are census-tier — and because it is a SUMMARY it is bound by a second rule as well: where a section above attaches a caveat to a result, this statement carries the caveat too or does not make the claim. Model coverage is a weaker fact and is stated plainly here: of those seventeen rows, five are covered by a gate in the two validators run for this document — C-71, C-72, C-78 and C-80 by name, and C-75 through the three T-28 corner gates that test its slow-mode identity against the independently computed commutant — two more are covered by gates in model/validate_formation.py (F-20, C-17), and ten carry none: G-10, G-11, C-41, O-35, C-66, C-87, O-2, F-11, O-10, C-86. C-86 and C-87 appear nowhere in model/ at all, so the channel clause's third leg and the whole alpha world clause are unrepresented in the URM. C-72's coverage is not the coverage it had: the check that formerly gated the occupancy half, 'C-71 occupancy: written ratio == 1 for EVERY pattern', IS GONE FROM model/validate_geometry.py — it compared against a literal and had no branch on which it could have come out otherwise (D-8) — and in its place stand six checks on the floor, the matched-N discriminator, its growth with N, and three D-15 controls in different configurations. What the model does enforce at its public gate is D-25: URM.surface() refuses a world-tier surface carrying no provenance and refuses a corner carrier that does not self-declare DEF-A, and two refusal gates plus a registry-lookup gate test that guard, all three passing. That guard is what stands behind the PROVENANCE strings in this layer's grounding cells (C-85) — and it is bypassable, and is bypassed inside the proof's own validator, which constructs RecordSurface directly, so not one number narrated in this layer passed through it. ProjectModel.roles() returns three sentences that no validator check fires on, and they are not the statement above: the returned Gamma sentence omits the channel, and its TD-1/T-37 and TD-2/T-15 pointers name debts whose plan tasks are both DONE.

This section is a summary of sections 1 to 5 and no clause of it is stronger than the block it summarises; where the earlier block's caveat is load-bearing it is repeated in the sentence that needs it, not parked here. A-PR is marked NOT-CARRIER-SHAPED by the T-52 audit extension — a role-assembly row whose every computed number lives in a cited row; the two-carrier property is a property of its citations, all seventeen verified TWO-CARRIER in the sealed table. THE STANDING BREACH, recorded by that audit: C-72, load-bearing in the EM-world clause, moved to PARTIAL after T-15 landed, breaching the restatement's own live-non-PARTIAL gate; the breach is registered, its disposition is T-50's, and until T-50 lands the roles statement's EM-world clause rests on C-71 alone. C-72's status moved after the T-15 lane was sealed, so the lane's non-PARTIAL condition is verified as of its sealing and not as of today, and the sentence above states which of the seventeen rows fails it and which clause that touches; the carrier marks are unaffected, since a T-9 verdict records which structurally different surfaces a row was run on and not whether its registered prediction survives. The named gate fires on the D-25 refusal sentence only, and that gate is a tool refusal about how surfaces enter the model, establishing nothing about any surface's physics; it is also bypassable, and the sealed lanes and the proof's own validator bypass it. claims.headline: em supplies the complex and the record
claims.prose: In the corner the record space is the homology of EM's own chain complex: the Z2 gauge degeneracy equals 2^dim H_1 on pinch-point complexes, a pure graph, and two tori wedged at a point (8 = 8, 4 = 4, 16 = 16), while the surface law 2 - chi fails on 7 of 11 carriers — G-10's ITEM still writes '6 of 11', the slip P-CORNER-8 records and this block does not reprint, and the sealed LANE_G10_NONMANIFOLD/g10_nonmanifold.txt carries seven SURFACE = FAILS rows, so an erratum to the row is owed (G-10). In the world the accumulated quantity that formation creates is electromagnetic on both of the surfaces the record rows name, and on neither was a device measured. WHAT THE OCCUPANCY SURFACE OWNS IS THE SIGN: the write injects one carrier sign on every programmed cell, so a page's net trapped charge carries the program carrier's sign — negative on an electron-injection part — for every data pattern whose page-level |sum Q| clears the surface's own declared unwritten tolerance, while a page below that tolerance is read as unwritten and carries no sign claim; and the unwritten page is null at -38 e inside that tolerance, +-5 e/cell (5000 e), from the same instrument in the same run (C-71). WHAT THIS BLOCK PREVIOUSLY CLAIMED HERE IS WITHDRAWN. 'Ratio exactly 1 for every data pattern' was an algebraic identity of scoring an erased cell at exactly zero charge, the check that gated it is gone from model/validate_geometry.py because it could not fail (D-8), and under the model's own +-5 e over-erase residual the ratio is pattern-dependent and reaches 1 on no page; C-72 now stands PARTIAL, blocked by T-50, and the ratio law is not restated as a prediction here or anywhere in this layer. WHAT SURVIVES OF C-72 IS A BOUND AND A SEPARATION, and both are now gated with failing branches. Through one instrument at one tolerance, the closed-form floor (Q_p f - D(1-f))/(Q_p f + D(1-f)) bounds every treated occupancy page from below — 0.904762 at f = 0.5 — and the worst treated page sits at 0.965292 at N = 1000, against the best of 200 treated orientation random pages at 0.091817: an 11x separation that widens to 112x at N = 1e5, because the occupancy floor contains no N and the orientation ceiling falls like 1/sqrt(N). The zero carries its positive controls in different configurations under the identical treatment: the unwritten page screens at 0.013909, BELOW the orientation ceiling, so screening is a property of the written state and not of the encoding label; the all-programmed page sits at the f -> 1 endpoint of the same floor at 1.000000; and the DC-saturated orientation page accumulates at 1.000000, so what screens the orientation random page is the data and not the tolerance the treatment adds (C-72). The orientation surface behaves as its encoding predicts on the same instrument: random data screens to 0.0027 at N = 1e5 — but the AC-erased control screens to 0.002620 on that same instrument, so the screening does not distinguish a demagnetised medium from a real data track, and one-signedness here belongs to DC-saturated writing alone, the encoding supplying no accumulating quantity for a medium that is carrying data (C-72, sealed seed 7). ProjectModel.formation_occupancy and ProjectModel.formation_orientation run both encodings through the single configuration instrument of the FORMATION layer.

claims.scope: The corner half is FORMAL — a statement about DEF-A carriers, not about the world (H-3) — and has no URM function of its own; ProjectModel.roles narrates it. The world half is the encoding-level statement only, and NO DEVICE WAS MEASURED: both surfaces are modelled, at 100 electrons per programmed floating gate with C_fg = 5.0e-18 F and at M_s V = 5.04e-19 A m^2, with data patterns drawn from sealed seeds 11 and 7 and constants pinned to literature classes, so no number in this half came from an instrument (P-FORM-9, P-FORM-12). claims.headline: gamma supplies space, writer, protection and channel
claims.prose: Capacity and protection are independent: a bouquet of k triangles has dim H_1 = 2, 3, 4 at true code distance d = 1, while the L x L torus has dim H_1 = 2 at d = 2, 3, 4 (G-11, whose ledger status is MEASURED and not FORMAL, so this is a sweep and not a theorem). On a D(G) carrier clause (iv) requires every eigenspace to be even-dimensional, and that direction is general: the parity broke on every odd group order tested and was unobstructed on every power-of-two one, the abelian Z_3 failing where the non-abelian D_4 passes, which makes it a statement about group order and not about commutativity. The verification is seven carriers over five groups, and records are actually constructed only on D(Z_2) and D(D_4), so C-41's registered quantifier over ALL D(G) is wider than the computation and that scope travels with the claim (C-41, O-35). The writer's weight is the earned geometry, and this clause carries both tiers: d_W satisfies all four metric axioms over all pairs and all triples on eight configuration venues and on two record venues — the barrier-work metric on a weighted hypercube Q_6 whose six weights are the census's published activation energies, and the hidden NAND-like interaction grid of LANE_T42_B_WORLDDIST — with a failing control on the same instrument, and neither record venue is an instrument reading of a device (C-78). The one pure-Gamma separation law is w_min = d on exhaustive coset scans of the (3,7) venue (C-80). Pure-Gamma two-region relations are identically zero beyond contact — I_IR = I_MI = 0 at every positive earned separation, every s, L to 12, exact over F_2 — against the single-contact seam law I_IR = 2(s-2) and, on width-2 rings at L = 8, a distance-independent winding constant I_IR = I_MI = IDENT = w = 2, as the positive controls in the same instrument; so no pure-Gamma falloff was EARNED on these venues and the falloff belongs to the declared coupling. That is a corner-tier null on a stabiliser carrier whose value set of -1, 0 and +1 forecloses a continuous profile in principle, and it reads two ways — as the different-shape hypothesis, or as no such structure being present — with neither reading a baseline (C-80). Protection in the world is energetic and not kinematic: twelve of the thirteen census records are erased only by a local operation at a finite energy price, the six with a measured barrier running E_b/kT from about 40 at the latch to 780 at SD magnetite, while the thirteenth, the CMB photon in free flight, carries no barrier at all and is flipped by the same local waveplate at about zero energy — so C-66's registered 'all thirteen ... 50 to 780' is wider than its own census table on the count and on the low end, and is owed an erratum; the mechanism is a different one from degeneracy and homology protection (C-66), whose corner form is the E_b -> infinity limit verified as a limit at 96/96, 1536/1536 and 24/24 slow modes against the independently computed commutant dimension (C-75). The channel is the coupling making the environment's evolution conditional on the record, so the divergence of the two conditional environment states is the copy and the record's value stays constant (F-20); clause (ii) is a condition on the environment (C-17); and a Gamma-priced coupling reaches three located classes with no fourth appearing in the swept family — C-87's registered EXACTLY THREE is wider than the sealed lane and its judge, and the weaker reading is what this clause carries (C-87, which has no URM function and no validator gate).

The writer clause carries BOTH tiers, as A-PR and the sealed T-15 table both mark it: C-78's eight configuration venues are corner-tier and its two record venues are world-tier, and the world venues are modelled — a hypercube whose weights are published activation energies and a hidden interaction grid — so neither is an instrument reading. C-41's quantifier over all D(G) is wider than the computation and the caveat travels: records are constructed on D(Z_2) and D(D_4) only, and clause (iv) is merely unobstructed on the other power-of-two carriers (P-CORNER-12). O-35 is cited for the minimal-torus D(S_3) parity failure it establishes; its own ITEM, 'NO NON-ABELIAN CARRIER WITH RECORDS HAS BEEN BUILT', is stale against its own sealed lane, which records D_4 as exactly that, and is owed an erratum. The two-region zero is scoped to the corner tier by the lane's own structural observation, does not preclude other venues, and is never a baseline (P-GEO-4). C-66's registered range is wider than the census table beneath it and an erratum is owed; the protection clause is world-tier census with C-75 as its corner limit form. G-11 is MEASURED, so capacity/protection independence is a sweep and not a theorem. C-87's registered EXACTLY THREE is not what this block carries; P-GEO-9 carries the same weaker reading. 'Gamma' names the third term by the function it performs and by nothing else — the program's registered candidate realisation is (H_1(Sigma), intersection pairing), which satisfies R1, R2 and R3 and is a CANDIDATE and not an identification (G-5) — and the debt sitting directly under that sentence is PF-11 (OPEN): the glossary mapping every program term to its standard name and owner is unwritten. No falloff exponent is asserted or required of the record level, and importing one would be the error (D-1). The corner role row A-GR is SINGLE-CARRIER (toric-2x2) by the audit and is context, never load-bearing.

claims.headline: alpha sets the cost, and alpha names a generic coupling strength
claims.prose: Alpha is a sum of local terms that splits the record space at order n*, the fewest available local terms whose product reaches the code space — and n* equals d only when the perturbation class is unrestricted (C-8): symmetry degeneracy splits at first order with slope = d on five codes, measured and not proved (O-2), and the formation threshold equals the destruction threshold at d, measured at d = 2 (F-11, cited here for its carrier mark and not as warrant — the register's D-10 classes its six-code verification as an instrument check with no branch on which it could have come out otherwise, and P-FORM-3 declines it on that ground); O-10's row still reads THE THRESHOLD=d SCALING IS UNTESTED, and only its EVIDENCE cell records the scaling as since proved for every stabiliser code and every coupling. In the world the cost appears as the barrier: each record's drop time t*_i = f0^-1 exp((B_i - dE_i)/kT)/(1 + exp(-dE_i/kT)) is set by its own barrier and bias with no fitted width anywhere in it, carrying one declared and underived assumption — a shared Kramers prefactor f0 for both wells — and the lane instrument agrees with the formula to 6.0e-15 relative on the two-well grid, with the count discrepancy 0 at all 1201 t_m points on both declared multi-record surfaces against a full eigendecomposition, a no-eigenmode decay-fit instrument and a 60-digit mpmath root. The positive control beside that zero is a DIFFERENT configuration and is not the staircase itself: the asymptotic candidate width B - kT ln(f0 t_m) misses by exactly 1 at 82 of those same points, and the lane's own declared D-15 control is the symmetric surface, where the staircase is flat at k = 8 with a single threshold exact to 1e-12. On the multi-pathway T-31 carrier, different again, the one-f0 closed form leaves 0.62 ln-unit residuals that exceed the local step gap, and it is that carrier at eps = 0.16, not the declared grids, whose staircase steps 2 -> 1 -> 0 (C-86). Alpha names a generic coupling strength — the magnitude of the local terms that do not respect the record's structure — and is NOT the fine structure constant; nothing in this corpus is dimensionful, and no conclusion depends on its value: over all 28 settings of the sealed sweep, spanning temperature beta, coupling lambda, bath size, time and five energy seeds, 28 are INVARIANT and 0 MOVED, while on the six-setting lambda arm alone chi[record] ran from 0.004158 at lambda = 0.05 to 0.979185 at lambda = 3.0 and chi[stabs] and chi[wt-1] stayed at machine zero, worst 4.4e-15 — the sensitivity control standing beside that zero in the sealed table (C-21, H-2). What alpha's value would set is the rate of formation, chi ~ lambda^(2n*), which is connected to no physical number. None of this is carried by the URM: no model function computes n*, the splitting slope, the threshold or k(t_m), C-86 appears nowhere in model/, and this block therefore names no model function and no gate.

claims.scope: The corner results are FORMAL statements about DEF-A carriers (H-3). C-8's own qualifier is carried in the sentence: n* = d only for an unrestricted perturbation class. F-11 is cited for its mark only and not as warrant, on the D-10 ground P-FORM-3 states. O-10 is cited with its own flag kept: the ITEM reads UNTESTED and only the EVIDENCE supersedes it, so the favourable half is never reported alone. 'Alpha' is a vocabulary stipulation registered as such, not a measurement: no number in this program is the fine structure constant. C-21's registered range, 0.0042 to 0.99996, spans all 28 settings including the beta arm, where chi[record] reaches 0.999962; the lambda figures quoted here are the coupling arm alone and are the narrower reading. Whether alpha's VALUE enters record durability through E_b is open and appears below as a debt, not as a result. The drop-time law's shared-f0 assumption is declared in T-47 A's own D-24 audit and is not derived, and on the only multi-shell carrier in the corpus the closed form's residual exceeds the local step gap, so the step order there is carried by the record-mode instrument and not by the formula (P-LAW-8). Nothing in this block has a model function or a validator gate — the drop-time instrument lives in the sealed T-47 lanes and the n*, slope and threshold results live in sealed lane scripts, outside the URM. claims.headline: the corner role rows are single-carrier and appear as context only
claims.prose: The three corner role rows are marked SINGLE-CARRIER by the sealed T-9 audit, each on toric-2x2: A-EM, A-GR and A-AL. The audit's refuter recorded why A-AL's claimed second carrier does not count — on toric-2x2 and Steane [[7,1,3]] n* = d, so the fitted exponents cannot discriminate the row's claim from eps^d, and the n* != d separation exists only on [[5,1,3]]. A-EM's evidence is the torus family and LANE_EM_EXTENT, and A-GR's theorems are all toric-family with the record-count lanes on the 2x2 and 2x3 torus alone. They therefore appear in the roles statement as context and never as a load-bearing citation; every load-bearing clause stands instead on a row the audit marked TWO-CARRIER. The audit's method — default SINGLE-CARRIER, an adversarial refuter required for every TWO-CARRIER claim — is stated once, in P-ROLES-9, and is not restated here. The ledger row that carries this requirement is PF-8 (OPEN) — every row re-run on at least two structurally different carriers — and T-9 is the plan task that ran the audit against it.

This is a statement about the ledger's carrier marks, not about physics: it does not say the three corner role rows are false, it says one carrier family supports them, so no step of the proof rests on them. The audit's methodology is P-ROLES-9's, and this block adds no second statement of it. PF-8 is OPEN and its denominator was corrected on 2026-08-20; the carrier discipline it registers is not discharged.

claims.headline: three of the four conditions on the emergence claim are not earned
claims.prose: The emergence claim's shape is the principal's and is registered: Gamma is the common structure that allows records to exist and appears at scale as geometry — shared origin (A-GR3) — stated over the boundary-shaping terms (A-GR4), under the binding caveat in the principal's own words that measures at the record level might behave differently from what has been seen in other contexts, so no behavioural assumption is imported as given and errors land on our measurements. The claim carries four conditions and three of them are not earned. OCCUPANCY OF CRITICALITY is PARTIALLY EARNED and scoped: C-91 eliminates the tuning freedom — occupancy is measure conservation of the surface's own writing, one computable bit, with the off-criticality alternative priced in closed form by the model's own erase channel — and the bit itself is not discharged, nothing in Gamma yet places the surface at criticality, and the surface's own critical point is not derived, since the constructions that would carry it are honest non-conserving ones; the scoping is the T-48 judge's own call, no pre-registered rule governs it, and its ratification sits with the principal (C-77, CANDIDATE). DESIGN-POINT ENFORCEMENT is NOT earned: which honest ensemble Gamma's actual writing enforces is undecided among three computed branches, and deciding it decides the occupancy bit too (O-58 N3). NORM SELECTION is open: the computed critical class is exact in an emergent Euclidean norm over earned L1 separation, and what norm the record's physics selects is unsettled (O-58 N4). Beside those three the anisotropy frontier is uncomputed — whether the D=3 class survives a biased-but-conserving ensemble weighting, and whether link indistinguishability can force the weight measure symmetric (O-58 N5). Three further rows of this family stand OPEN and are named here so they need not be read between the lines: the boundary-law coefficient is venue-dependent, 32 at the corner and 216 at the world tier, and no coefficient on the record surface has been shown universal (O-55); no temperature-like and no energy-like quantity has yet been earned on the record surface by D-24's standard, so the thermodynamic pair does not exist to be used (O-56); and the emergent content bound — whether a record-level dynamics makes stored content in excess of certifiable content unstable — is a staged target and not a result (O-57). The fourth condition, that a unique critical member exists, is O-58's N1 and is closed; it is reported with its scope in section 6. C-72 — sign-definiteness is supplied by the encoding the formation process chooses — now stands PARTIAL, BLOCKED_BY T-50. Two independent refuters, each rebuilding the arithmetic from model/geometry.py before opening a lane script, both returned REFUTED, and the ground is runnability rather than arithmetic: the ratio is not translation-free, so it needs V_t,neutral to better than the tolerance it is bounding — not a datasheet number — while the proposed text forbade the one reference a V_t histogram does supply, the erased population's own median. The closed-form floor (Q_p f - D(1-f))/(Q_p f + D(1-f)) is confirmed and TIGHT — attained exactly when every erased cell sits at +D — and it contains no N. The accumulate-versus-screen discriminator is computed, adversarially confirmed by both refuters, and now GATED WITH FAILING BRANCHES where the artifact check that could not fail has been removed: six checks in model/validate_geometry.py put the worst treated occupancy page at 0.965292 against the best of 200 treated orientation random pages at 0.091817 at N = 1000, an 11x separation widening to 112x at N = 1e5, with three D-15 controls beside them in different configurations under the identical treatment — the all-programmed page at the f -> 1 endpoint at 1.000000, the unwritten page screening at 0.013909 below the orientation ceiling, and the DC-saturated orientation page accumulating at 1.000000.
